decisions.reason: The upgraded trommel screen has positive customer feedback and meets aspirations, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
The flail shredder line extends the shredder portfolio and has its own page, and slack allows carrying it while demand develops.
The stationary electric fine shredder remains a niche product with limited web presence, but slack permits carrying it while results are still uncertain.
The specialized green-waste grinder now has a clearer niche after the general grinder was dropped, but its limited presence warrants moderate risk.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line complements existing pre-shredders and has its own page, so it is likely meeting aspirations.
